children.text: At Gimetry Studio we get to do work we believe in, with people we respect, for ideas that matter. We're lucky to do what we do and that's pretty great.

If you have a brand, a launch or a campaign that needs to look like it means it, we would like to hear about it. We take on a small number of projects at a time so each one gets the people who designed it, start to finish.

careers.metaDescription: Gimetry Studio partners with brands, agencies and venues on brand identity, web and motion work. Here is how we like to work together.

values.description: Projects run with the people who designed them still attached. No handoff to a team you have not met, no drift between the pitch and what ships.
values.title: Small by choice

values.description: You know your business better than we ever will. We ask the awkward questions early, then build from the answers rather than around them.
values.title: Collaborate and listen

values.description: Every project is a chance to make something worth showing. We would rather build one thing properly than five things that look like everyone else.
values.title: Make it count
